programs.name: PINNACLE - Two Year Integrated School Program
programs.summary: The ultimate synchronized program integrating senior secondary school syllabus with JEE Advanced coaching within school hours, eliminating extra commute.
keyFeatures: Zero collision between School & JEE study schedules
Comprehensive coverage of Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics
Simultaneous preparation for Board Exams (100% focused) & JEE Advanced
Regular Chapter Practice Problems (CPP) & All India Internal Test Series (AI²TS)
Dedicated doubt clearing sessions & personalized performance mentoring
programs.eligibility: Admission through FTRE / FIITJEE Admission Test / Big Bang Edge Test
programs.recommendedFor: Students entering Class XI aiming for Top 500 AIR in JEE Advanced without dual-stress of school and coaching.

programs.name: Two Year Classroom Program for JEE (Advanced)
programs.summary: FIITJEE’s legendary classroom program designed to build deep conceptual clarity, analytical thinking, and exam temperament from fundamentals to IIT-JEE level.
keyFeatures: Over 850+ hours of intense, pattern-proof classroom teaching
Standardized FIITJEE Study Package + Grand Master Package (GMP)
Computer-Based All India Test Series (AITS) with national percentile benchmarking
Pattern-Proof testing to excel regardless of changing JEE paper patterns
Rankers Study Material & Compendium with solution archive
programs.eligibility: Selection via FTRE or General Admission Test
programs.recommendedFor: Serious aspirants starting Class XI dedicated to securing Top IIT branches (CSE, MnC, Electrical).

programs.name: SUPREME - Four Year Integrated School Program
programs.summary: Starts right after Class VIII. Develops profound mathematical rigor and scientific temperament while smoothly covering 9th-12th school curricula.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive 4-Year roadmap spanning Class IX to XII
Mastery over Olympiads (Physics, Astronomy, Math, Chemistry) & Junior Science
Seamless transition from Foundation concepts to advanced JEE calculus and mechanics
Exclusive batch mentoring by Senior FIITJEE HODs
programs.recommendedFor: Motivated students moving from Class VIII to IX targeting Top 100 AIR in JEE Advanced.

programs.name: ASCENT - Two Year Classroom Program
programs.summary: Cultivates sharp logical deduction, raises IQ, and strengthens Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics & Mental Ability for national olympiads.
keyFeatures: Mental Ability & Analytical Reasoning training
Advance coverage of Class IX & X Science & Math for Olympiad podiums
Foundation for early JEE Advanced preparation
Quarterly National level benchmarking and diagnostic reports
programs.recommendedFor: Class 9 students aiming for Olympiads and creating an unbeatable base for 11th/12th JEE prep.

programs.name: UDAYA - Two Year Foundation Program
programs.summary: Ignites curiosity, transforms how young minds think, and builds rock-solid basics in Science and Mathematics through discovery-based learning.
keyFeatures: Focus on "Thinking Skills" rather than rote memorization
Conceptual experiment demonstrations and speed math shortcuts
School syllabus enhancement with high-order thinking problems (HOTS)
Regular interactive quizzes and parent-teacher counseling
programs.recommendedFor: Class 7 students seeking strong scientific aptitude and school exam excellence.

programs.name: LITTLE GENIE - One Year Foundation Program
programs.summary: Specially crafted for 6th graders to eliminate fear of math & science, boost IQ, and build structured study habits early.
keyFeatures: Fun-filled logical puzzles, spatial reasoning, and science games
Strengthening elementary algebra, arithmetic, and basic physics
Personal attention with small batch sizes
programs.recommendedFor: Class 6 students to develop a passion for problem solving.

programs.name: Special One Year Classroom Program for XII Pass / Dropper
programs.summary: A rigorously calibrated intensive program for 12th pass students to eliminate weaknesses, perfect problem-solving speed, and jump 5,000+ ranks.
keyFeatures: 6 days/week high-intensity problem solving and concept revision
Full Computer-Based All India Test Series (CBT-AITS) included
Grand Master Package (GMP) with 1500+ handpicked challenging problems
Rigorous error analysis and rank booster modules
programs.eligibility: JEE Main Percentile / Board Marks / Direct Test
programs.recommendedFor: Passout students determined to achieve a top rank in their next attempt.

programs.name: FIITJEE eSchool - Live 2-Way Interactive Online
programs.targetClasses: Class VI to XII & XII Pass
programs.summary: Brings the legendary FIITJEE classroom pedagogy to your home. Live audio-video interaction with premier faculty, digital whiteboard, and instant doubt resolution.
keyFeatures: Live 2-Way Interactive Classes (Not pre-recorded videos)
Digital Study Material + Hard Copy dispatched to your doorstep
Online Computer-Based Tests with AI-powered performance analytics
Live online doubt clearing rooms 6 days a week
programs.recommendedFor: Students in cities without a physical FIITJEE center or seeking flexible home-based learning.

programs.name: Computer Based All India Test Series (AITS)
programs.summary: The gold standard test series taken by 90%+ of top 1000 IIT rankers across India. Replicates actual JEE CBT interface with intricate national rank predictor.
keyFeatures: 24+ Part & Full Syllabus CBT Tests on exact NTA / IIT-JEE interface
Video solutions and detailed step-by-step diagnostic analysis
Real-time All India Rank, Percentile, and Topic-wise accuracy metrics
Concept strengthening RTPF (Rankers Test Paper File)
programs.recommendedFor: Students needing real exam simulation and all-India ranking before the main exams.

toppers.name: Nithin Babu
toppers.program: Meet Nithin Babu- Who Went from scoring a mere 33% in our Admission Test to securing AIR 216 in JEE Advanced with the help of FIITJEE. “To be an IITian is one dream I always wanted to fulfil, but being an average performer, I was never encouraged until I approached FIITJEE. Convinced with proven results of FIITJEE for decades, I decided to appear for its Admission Test on 6th April 2014, in which I scored only 33% with no scholarship. I then joined the FIITJEE Four Year Classroom Program, wherein I witnessed many other Students like me already gaining benefits from the guidance of its expert faculty. The teachers worked 360 degrees to plug in my academic loopholes. FIITJEE’s support and my determination together have made me a proud IITian in Madras, with an All India Rank 216 in JEE Advanced 2018.

toppers.name: Kartikay Goel
toppers.program: Meet Kartikay Goel, a Student with 30% in the admission test but AIR 518 in JEE Advanced. “I thank the day when I decided to join FIITJEE. Even after being an average academic performer, I planned to appear for the FIITJEE Admission Test on 27th April 2014 but scored only 30% with no scholarship. I joined its Four-Year Classroom Program. Since I joined it in Class IX only, I could take maximum benefits from the provided study materials and systematic test schedules. Joining early made my foundation concrete when I reached Class X, ultimately boosting my secondary Class performance. Only by following FIITJEE, my dream of becoming an IITian was accomplished, and I’m now studying at IIT Guwahati after clearing JEE Advanced with an All India Rank 518. Hearty thanks to FIITJEE.”

toppers.name: Ira Pachori
toppers.program: Meet Ira Pachori, a doctor who benefitted from FIITJEE’s coaching during her Class IX and X. “I am a doctor, and I did my MBBS from AIIMS, New Delhi. I studied at FIITJEE in Class IX and X, which gave me an advantage of enhanced analytical and improved decision-making skills. This gave me enough confidence to pursue the Medical stream later in Class XI and XII. The principles learnt at FIITJEE are benefiting me even now. Indeed, joining FIITJEE till Class X was the apt decision for me.”

toppers.name: Barkha Singh
toppers.program: Meet Barkha Singh, a lawyer grateful to FIITJEE for her analytical skills and her ability to clear CLAT. “To achieve my aim of building a career in law, I took Humanities in Class XI and XII. To develop my analytical and reasoning skills and logical thinking, I chose to study at FIITJEE from Class VIII to X. Only because FIITJEE taught me to solve analytical reasoning questions integral to competitive exams, I could clear CLAT. Today, I am enrolled in BA LLB at Nalsar, Hyderabad.”

toppers.name: Srishti Chopra
toppers.program: Meet Srishti Chopra, an economics honours Student with exceptional critical-thinking skills. “It was my pre-set goal to choose Commerce after Class X and make a career in Economics. And to strengthen my mathematics and critical-thinking skills, I joined FIITJEE from Class VII to X. Those 4 years of beneficial learning made me academically sound to pursue Economics Honours from Indraprastha University, New Delhi.”

toppers.name: Abhishek Sharma
toppers.program: Meet Abhishek Sharma, a management professional who appreciates FIITJEE’s contribution to his success. “I wanted to become a management professional and, thus, took Arts in Class XI and XII to cement my academic foundation. I studied at FIITJEE in Class IX and X. FIITJEE developed my IQ and strategic thinking skills and infused me with enough confidence to pursue my BBE. Today, I am doing an MBA in Marketing, and the learnings of FIITJEE still remain the biggest support in my life and career.”

toppers.name: Keerthi Vasan
toppers.program: Meet Keerthi Vasan, an IAS officer who was able to crack UPSC exams with FIITJEE’s learning formula. “I am an IAS officer and always wanted to be one. Since I wanted to opt for the Science stream in Class XI and XII, I joined FIITJEE right in Class IX and continued studying till Class XII. This enhanced my IQ and developed rational thinking and problem-solving tactics prerequisites to crack the UPSC exam. The learning at FIITJEE helps me to date in real-life applications.”

why_fiitjee_points.title: Pattern-Proof Teaching Methodology
why_fiitjee_points.desc: Our faculty prepares students to master fundamental principles so deeply that changes in examination pattern (from subjective to objective, multi-correct, matrix match, numerical integer) never throw them off.

why_fiitjee_points.title: Comprehensive Study Material & GMP
why_fiitjee_points.desc: Rankers Study Material (RSM) and Grand Master Package (GMP) with 1500+ curated problems have remained the undisputed gold standard in competitive test prep for over 3 decades.

why_fiitjee_points.title: National Level Benchmarking (AITS & AI²TS)
why_fiitjee_points.desc: With tens of thousands of top brains competing on the same test, students receive precise all-India percentile projections and micro-topic diagnostic heatmaps.

why_fiitjee_points.title: Full-Time Dedicated Faculty Ecosystem
why_fiitjee_points.desc: Unlike generic coaching hubs, all FIITJEE faculty are full-time, exclusively trained through rigorous faculty development programs and strictly monitored for instructional quality.

why_fiitjee_points.title: Holistic Student Development & Mental Conditioning
why_fiitjee_points.desc: Beyond academics, regular motivational seminars, stress management, speed-enhancement drills, and meditation sessions keep aspirants peak-ready.

why_fiitjee_points.title: Integrated Synchronized Schooling
why_fiitjee_points.desc: PINNACLE and SUPREME models save 4-5 hours of daily travel and school-coaching scheduling friction, giving students crucial extra self-study hours.
